item.title: 科研播客 - 2026-02-14
item.description: 本期讨论文章： - 宿主遗传因素与人类肠道微生物组成的关联研究 - 基因组内插在猪繁殖性状GWAS中的应用 - 莱茵-默兹河流域的狩猎采集者血统与贝娄文化扩张 - 全基因组关联分析揭示肠道分子环境对微生物多样性的影响 - 16种癌症类型中染色体改变和突变签名的全面分析 - Avr基因变异解释小麦杆锈病的严重流行 - 黑羽鸡遗传选择对生长和营养的影响 - 评估Oxford Nanopore测序在临床应用中的可行性 - 黑羽鸡肉用种鸡的繁殖相关基因识别 - 用于高效分子数量性状位点映射的OmiGA工具 - 白蚁中自私遗传元素与宿主防御的军备竞赛 - 沙特阿拉伯基因组医学的发展 - 西非遗传医学中心应对非洲遗传疾病挑战 - 猪到人肾移植生理学和免疫学 - 睡眠依赖的脑脂质清除 - 新疆褐牛MSTN敲除与代谢组学 - 代谢组学和脂质组学在畜禽繁殖研究中的应用 - sRNA测序分析编码基因表达 - 黄曲霉中lncRNA与抗真菌敏感性

item.title: 科研播客 - 2026-02-15
item.description: 本期讨论文章： - The HUNT study identifies host genetic factors reproducibly associated with human gut microbiota composition - Genome Imputation for Genome-Wide Association Study of Reproductive Traits in Chinese Duroc, Landrace, and Yorkshire Pigs: Strategy and Validation - Lasting Lower Rhine–Meuse forager ancestry shaped Bell Beaker expansion - Genome-wide association analyses highlight the role of the intestinal molecular environment in human gut microbiota variation - Comprehensive repertoire of the chromosomal alteration and mutational signatures across 16 cancer types - Allelic variation of Avr genes in highly virulent strains explains severe wheat stem rust epidemics - Author Correction: Inference and reconstruction of the heimdallarchaeial ancestry of eukaryotes - Assessing the readiness of Oxford Nanopore sequencing for clinical genomics applications - Effects of Genetic Selection on Growth, Nutritional Value, and Amino Acid Profiles of Breast Muscle and Blood in Black-Boned Chickens - Genome characteristics and identification of reproduction-related genes in Southwest meat goats - Arms races between selfish genetic elements and their host defence in termites - The West African Genetic Medicine Center as a model to address the challenge of genetic disorders in Africa - Publisher Correction: Physiology and immunology of a pig-to-human decedent kidney xenotransplant - Strategies to improve on selection based on estimated breeding values - Sleep-dependent clearance of brain lipids by peripheral blood cells - Early Growth and Serum Metabolic Profiling of One-Month-Old MSTN-Knockout Xinjiang Brown Cattle via CRISPR/Cas12Mix - Metabolomics and Lipidomics in the Study of Reproductive Performance in Livestock - Limited codiversification of the gut microbiota with humans - Genomic Insights into the Origins, Population Structure, and Local Adaptation of Philippine Visayan Native Cattle - Robust partitioning of cell contents by physical instabilities and biological clocks
